'''Kiimo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kiimo and the bounty hunters [[Dee'Hars]], [[Kelyan]] and [[Clargod]] traveled to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], planning to capture [[Mattenic]] and [[Kerkum]], two former [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] of the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. Clargod and the rest of the team claimed to be in the employ of the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a law enforcement body that had placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Mattenic and Kerkum. However, they were also working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]], who had recently seized control of crime in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] from Nirama, and the bounty hunters planned to get paid twice for capturing the pair. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were also looking for Mattenic and Kerkum, and they prevented Clargod and the other bounty hunters from capturing the pair.<ref name="Preemptive Strike" />

A short time afterward, the Heroes of Cularin destroyed Riboga's [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on the planet [[Kemix]],<ref name="Counterstrike">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Counterstrike}}</ref> so the Hutt hired Kiimo, Clargod, Dee'Hars, and Kelyan to bring the heroes into a state of despair, and then [[Death/Legends|kill]] them. The bounty hunters placed explosives aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that the heroes were traveling on and then detonated the devices, bringing the heroes' craft out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and causing it to crash on the planet [[Holador]]. The bounty hunters then landed on the world and assembled a mock-up of a starship to distract the heroes, and Kiimo laid in wait for them beneath it. When the heroes approached the fake starship, Kiimo detonated some explosives to try and take then out. However, the heroes survived her trap and subsequently defeated her in combat<ref name="Strike III">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Strike III}}</ref>
